name: Pune Ring Road
title: Pune Ring Road (MSRDC): status and timeline
summary: The outer ring road around Pune built by MSRDC, in an eastern and a western arm.
means: Ring Road news is mostly money and land so far. Before you count it in a home's location, ask how far the nearest planned entry point is and check the latest stage here.

history.status: The state approved Rs 10,502 crore for the 32 km Soratapwadi to Varve Budruk stretch of the eastern arm, to be built by MSRDC.
The Bombay High Court dismissed a challenge to the project's land acquisition notification.

The project's cost is reported up by Rs 10,502 crore, to about Rs 53,213 crore, after the state took a stretch over from NHAI and gave the work to MSRDC. The High Court dismissed a challenge to its land acquisition on 11 October.
